titulo: From chat to agent: the four steps
lead: In chat, you guide everything, and when you close the window, the work stops. An agent reads your files, performs tasks, and keeps going while you do something else. The shift isn't about changing models: it's about changing where you work.
objetivo: say which step you're at today and what concrete step comes next.

aprende.t: The four steps and the order they follow

secoes.sub: Each step builds on the one before it. If you skip the first, you’ll get stuck on the next three.

nos.detalhe: The agent (Claude Code or Codex) works inside one of your folders, reads a rulebook (AGENTS.md), and lets you undo any mistake with Git. This is the foundation for everything that comes next.
With INTELECTO, you get your own Telegram assistant, with memory and a style you define, using a cloud or local model.

nos.sub: Ten tasks, then go to sleep
nos.detalhe: inemaccbot saves each request as a task, resumes where it left off, and stops at a gate when it needs your approval.
r7e, promoavatar, and the xviral tools (finviral, saudeviral, advviral) publishing regularly, with verified numbers and the source on screen.

secoes.volta: Each step reuses the one before it: folder, rules, secrets, and gate
secoes.legenda: No magic: there’s no “render while you sleep” if the system doesn’t run correctly.

rolagem_fim.texto: Each step reuses the one before it: the terminal folder and rules, the .env with the keys, the queue that stores tasks, and the gate before anything important. That’s why the order is essential.

secoes.sub: Click the situation that sounds most like you today.

texto: Start with step 1. Do OSWork Quick, then the six exercises in sequence 1.
First-week goal: get to your folder using only the terminal and watch the agent create a file inside it.

exemplo.texto: Open the terminal and create the projetos/meu-primeiro-agente folder.

texto: You’re already at step 1. Check that you have AGENTS.md, Git, and .env in .gitignore; if so, move on to step 2.
Install your Jarvis with INTELECTO and take its course.
Queue time. Before installing inemaccbot, run the 30-line homegrown queue to understand entrada, feito, and falhou.
Then list 10 repetitive tasks and mark where a gate is needed.

exemplo.texto: Fill in the table of 10 tasks, with at least two that have a gate.

texto: Step 4. Use r7e for the format and finviral as a model for your niche’s channel.
Write your niche rules before automating: without a queue and a gate, automating social media means posting the wrong thing faster.

exemplo.texto: Choose 5 reference channels and write canais.md and regras.md.

secoes.sub: Copy it, fill it in, and save it in your project folder. It becomes your learning roadmap.

Writing down your starting point helps you avoid the most common mistake: skipping step 1 because it seems simple. The diagnosis is also the first file the agent will read when you get to the terminal.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: What’s the key difference between chat and an agent?
opcoes: The agent uses a smarter model.
The agent works with your files and keeps going without you directing every step.
perguntas.explica: The shift isn’t about switching models; it’s about changing where you work. The agent reads your folder, runs tasks, and keeps working when you close the window.

opcoes: Because the terminal is only required on Windows.
Because folders, the terminal, AGENTS.md, and secrets kept out of the text are the foundation for the other three.
Because Jarvis only runs after a month of use.
Because the course requires a specific order to issue a certificate.
perguntas.explica: If you skip sequence 1, you’ll get stuck in the other three. Assistants, queues, and social media all use folders, rules, .env, and Git all the time.

perguntas.p: You already use Claude Code in your folder, have AGENTS.md, and use Git. What’s the next step?
opcoes: Install the queue before the assistant.
Go back to chat to practice prompts.
perguntas.explica: With step 1 in place, the next step is your own assistant: write meu-jarvis.md and install INTELECTO.
